prompt: Staff often book a whole course of treatment for one patient with one doctor. Add `POST /api/appointments/series` taking `{"doctorId": 1, "patientId": 1, "slotStarts": ["2030-01-02T03:00:00Z", ...]}` (RFC 3339 timestamps, in any order). Either every slot is booked, answered with 201 and `{"appointments": [...]}` in the order requested, each entry shaped like a single booking's appointment; or none is booked and the response is the refusal the first failing slot would have got as a single booking. A series must never leave part of itself behind, and all the usual booking rules apply to every slot in it.
outOfScope: single booking behaviour and its fault codes
